# Glyph

A bordered tile carrying a mark for a connector or a kind of thing.

## Anatomy

A rounded square at the given size, with either a caller-supplied mark or a single display-face character centred in it.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mark` | `Snippet` | — | The mark inside the tile. A brand logo is supplied by the caller as an inline SVG snippet — the reference masks one in from a CDN, which an offline application cannot do. |
| `char` | `string` | — | The typographic fallback the reference uses when it has no logo for a kind. |
| `size` | `number` | — | — |
| `label` | `string` | — | Names the tile when it is the only thing identifying what it stands for. |

## Variants

Mark or character.

## States

Static.

## Keyboard

Not interactive.

## ARIA

Decorative unless given a `label`.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.

## Recorded deviations

| What | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Brand marks are supplied by the caller rather than masked in from a CDN. | The reference loads its logos from `cdn.simpleicons.org`, which an offline desktop application cannot reach. The tile takes a snippet, so the mark is bundled by whoever uses it. |
